entries.3cd56efd7ea44b6d: The company sells consumables such as toner cartridges, ink ribbons, ink cartridges and general-purpose OA paper used in printing devices such as laser printers and multifunction devices.
entries.6864a89c4e280814: This is the foundation business of the company group, selling office-related products such as reused products, OA supply products, and stationery and office supplies to business customers. The company refurbishes and sells reused products and sells OA supply products through its members-only EC site 'YORIDORI'; consolidated subsidiary Seiun Kuraun Co., Ltd. sells stationery and office supplies, office furniture and OA equipment; and Kitabutsu Chubu Co., Ltd. handles the logistics business and warehousing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2026 was ¥15,372 million.
entries.789ae8cf7e5aecaf: The company sells repacked toner, repacked ribbons, repacked ink and repacked gel, made by refurbishing used toner cartridges, ink ribbons, ink cartridges and cartridges for gel-jet printers. The company carries out refurbishing work at plants such as the one in Komagane, Nagano Prefecture.
entries.84cde58c381ea357: Consolidated subsidiary Tokai Sakurai Co., Ltd. carries out document scanning and digitization, sells consumables for drawings, produces bookbinding, sells stationery and office supplies, and rents OA equipment such as multifunction devices.
entries.8a7d6eea81b794f8: Consolidated subsidiary Seiun Kuraun Co., Ltd. sells stationery and office supplies, office furniture and OA equipment, and proposes and sells the 'Office Purchasing System.' The company also sells office-related products and other items through its members-only EC site for offices, 'YORIDORI.'
entries.9317db72aee9e674: A company that sells reuse products such as repacked toner and OA supplies to businesses, and also handles IT solutions such as multifunction printers and PCs.
entries.a54c1790abb87e13: Consolidated subsidiaries Seiun Kuraun Co., Ltd., SBM Solution Co., Ltd. and S&S Co., Ltd. carry out operations relating to multifunction device sales and maintenance and network security.
entries.a8e0d4ee245d34e0: Stationery and office supplies, office furniture, etc.

entries.d4ebcb484205f12d: Consolidated subsidiary Ikoris Co., Ltd. carries out algorithm analysis for online business, digital marketing, EC business and EC operation support, while Jibun Space Co., Ltd. handles EC site operation, website creation, video editing, SNS management and similar work. Jibun Space Co., Ltd. operates a Type A continuous employment support facility specializing in IT.
entries.e177d2777d2fbb9d: This is a growth business of the company group that sells products supporting DX promotion, including PCs and software, as well as multifunction devices and network-related products. The company handles document, PC environment and network products, while consolidated subsidiaries handle operations such as multifunction device sales and maintenance, network security, digital marketing, EC operation support, and document scanning and digitization. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2026 was ¥4,820 million.
entries.e593bd01947b7168: Consolidated subsidiary Kitabutsu Chubu Co., Ltd. carries out the logistics business and warehousing business, which handle the company group's logistics operations.
entries.fc2eba0f0784918b: The company sells document products such as multifunction devices, electronic document management, OCR and scanning; PC environment products such as PCs, mobile PCs, WEB conferencing and digital whiteboards; and network products such as communication lines, routers, UTMs, network cameras and website production.
